reasons: The genuine claim differs from the planted one only in its later_events effective dates: EO 13726 is dated 2016-04-19, matching its text, 'Executive Order 13726 of April 19, 2016', which has no separate effective-date clause, and the Notice of February 13, 2026 is dated 2026-02-13 on all 29 clauses (91 FR 7801, FR Doc. 2026-03279). Everything else was already checked in the blind review. Every quoted span matches the held bytes. Identity is confirmed: 76 FR 11315, February 25, 2011. The 29-scope inventory runs from the emergency declaration through sec. 14 and omits nothing operative. The notice continues the emergency declared on February 25, 2011 and expanded on April 19, 2016 beyond February 25, 2026, so every clause stood on 2026-10-14. The OFR See notes (EO 13726; the 2026 notice) are addressed, and the cruden search shows no revocation or amendment.
